integrity: Complete self-contained finite-field proof with a standard-library finite-case checker; bounded enumeration is explicitly distinguished from the all-parameter theorem. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Counts only F_q-linear algebra homomorphisms, equivalently F_q-linear homomorphisms of the associated radical brace; does not count all prime-field-linear brace homomorphisms when q is nonprime, or arbitrary three-step nilpotent rings. Historical equivalences may exist.
title: Goursat strata and complete retraction ranks of block-unitriangular radical braces
